subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should outbound Telegram albums become a supported message-tool/channel behavior now, and should maintainers port the open external draft PR or replace it with a narrower current-main implementation?
rationale: The request adds a user-visible Telegram capability and message/action API shape, and the existing open draft implementation may not be the right current-main boundary; automation should not choose the permanent API shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Port or review the draft PR
options.body: Use the existing external draft as the starting point, but require a current-main port, focused tests, and real Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Supersede with a fresh implementation
options.body: Close or ignore the draft and design a narrower implementation directly around the current action, reply, and outbound adapter paths.

options.title: Defer album grouping
options.body: Keep the current sequential media fanout as the supported behavior for now and leave album grouping out of scope until maintainers sponsor it.

recommendation.title: Port or review the draft PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing external draft as the starting point, but require a current-main port, focused tests, and real Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already handled prior maintainer cleanup on this issue and current history ties the same account to the central Telegram media send/action surfaces.
